title: server_started data
description: Emitted after a successful server start. Correlated with the start_server command id.

addr.description: Address the server is bound to, with the port the system picked when start_server asked for port 0. Empty for a relay server.

fingerprint_numeric.description: Numeric fingerprint: 40 digits in eight groups of five, the code for peers to compare when they verify the server.
